OmniControl Suite v9.0.0 - Ground-Up Rebuild:
- Completely rebuilt application architecture with clean, robust Program.cs entry point.
- Eliminated all recursive Win32 handle allocations and hidden state initializers.
- Full 6-tab Google Stitch OLED Neon Precision user interface.
- Live ACPI battery discharge in Watts, HP BIOS 60/80/100% battery limiter, OptiRouter AI, 0.5ms MMIO timer, and Temp Tamer.
